negative_reviews.author: Zayana
negative_reviews.text: The ramen broth felt quite salty and overpowering so couldn’t taste the actual broth. The noodles felt a bit off as well. Good halal options though. Service was quick and easy.

negative_reviews.author: Nicholas Cooper
negative_reviews.text:
Service was great, food portions sizes were great too, but felt the actual taste was a bit bland.
For reference I had:
- Squid Tempura - with adding soy there wasn't much flavour to the tempura
- Steak Tataki Ramen - the broth was ok (was expecting better) and the steak itself had no flavour or seasonin

negative_reviews.author: A Rö
negative_reviews.text: Ramen was okay not really special, service and atmosphere really good and nice. But never order the lemonades here, tasting artificial and served in cheap plastic cups. 🐥

negative_reviews.author: cristiano rodrigues
negative_reviews.text: The staff are extremely arrogant, especially a tall white man. The food took nearly an hour, and the atmosphere was chaotic.

negative_reviews.author: Sabi Syangtan
negative_reviews.text: Very disappointing service. We ordered water and had to ask several times, but it was brought only after a long wait in a dirty bottle, which raised serious concerns about hygiene. The staff also seemed confused and disorganised. On top of that, the food portions were too small for the price. Overall, poor service, hygiene,and not value for money.

negative_reviews.author: Jade Friend
negative_reviews.text:
Firstly we had to wait a while even though there was loads of empty seats.
Look ages to get served, even though there was multiple staff. The food took a while and was not great, It was pretty bland and needed something else. My drink wasn’t too bad but my friends lychee lemonade was ridiculously sweet.

When I asked for the bill I also said I had a tastecard code. The guy decided to tell me I should’ve booked to let them know.. I hadn’t had a problem before, plus some places say it on the app, this one didn’t.
He never even brought me the bill and decided to keep serving other people. Which I found very rude, I just wanted to leave it was loud from the staff shouting and super hot. I didn’t get the guys name but he was a tall white guy that look like he’d been in a fight all busted up.
I had to get someone else to get me the bill.
I should’ve refused service charge.

Also the toilets were absolutely disgusting. Stunk, tissue everywhere, poo splattered up toilets.
Liked like the place was falling apart. There was even a railing coming off the way wall we moved as we went up the stairs. We didn’t notice until my friend grabbed on and almost fell from it coming away.

Would not recommend and certainly will not be going back.

negative_reviews.author: Itai Moses (‫אתי‬‎)
negative_reviews.text:
We came here as it was half price for food on first table. Glad that we did not pay full price, and not even sure it was worth it with half price off.

We got edamame which were clearly heated from frozen, veg gyozas were okay.

Veg ramen was okay, the broth was decent but it was mainly just noodles, no veggies or extras. The tofu was meant to be fried tofu but was just soft and plain.

Fried chicken was fatty and poor quality meat, cooked from frozen and seemed to be undercooked. Same issue with chicken soba.

Boba was nice but served with a tiny straw so you couldn’t even drink it properly!

Think based on the reviews this is a tourist trap, but you can get far better quality ramen in London for the price.

issues: Covers were down on the previous week, most likely because a promotional period ended, and although the site hit its sales target, sales fell against the previous week, so the team discussed how to improve retention and grow towards the weekly sales goal.
The delivery station is messy and needs to be cleaned and organised daily, with bags, soy sauce and utensils kept stocked on the shelf.

Missing items in delivery orders are a recurring problem, causing customer frustration and putting review scores at risk, and the practice of asking drivers to return for missing items compromises food quality and must stop in favour of a correct packing process verified by a checklist.
Back of house labour needs to be reduced while front of house labour is performing well, and the team is managing breaks during slower periods and focusing on upselling.
Recent one star reviews stemmed from a delivery driver dispute and from confusion over Taste Card bookings.

Staff have been checking for reservations even when the restaurant is empty, and the site should instead seat customers immediately and apply Taste Card discounts without unnecessary administrative hurdles.

Rigid reservation enforcement is being relaxed so that guests are seated immediately even when the site is busy, as time spent at the door checking reservations is less productive than serving guests.
Staff must avoid arguing with guests over reservations or discount cards, as a recent two star review reportedly deterred potential customers and the priority is customer happiness and retention.

Toilet hygiene has slipped, as a deep clean was carried out but frequent daily checks are required, and specific areas such as the wall under the hand dryer and behind the toilets were not cleaned by staff (Bing) despite clear instructions.
A complaint about dirty water bottles has been resolved and all bottles are now clean, and a separate complaint involved an impatient delivery driver while the team was prioritising dining guests.
The VIP area needs a deep clean.
The site has been turning away large groups, so the Red Bull Gaming partnership activation is being relocated from Soho to Shoreditch from next week.

Region-wide (South England): The brand weekly average review rating is trending below target and needs to improve, as a single negative review can drag the average down despite many positive ones, so consistent cleaning and service standards are needed across the region.
Region-wide (South England): A memo on the correct use of discount buttons is being issued and needs to be checked by the group for accuracy so that discounts are recorded and tracked correctly.
